overview.text: 重 means “heavy” or “double; repeated.” A Han-dynasty dictionary glosses it “thick/deep” and analyzes 壬 as semantic and 東 as phonetic, but the graph’s origin remains uncertain.

components.text: The dictionary assigns 壬 a semantic role; “thick/deep” is its gloss for the whole character, not proof of the original picture.
The dictionary treats 東 as a sound element; its analysis does not settle the graph’s origin.
